summary: Updated accepted proposal with Mermaid addendum. Scope now includes first-class Mermaid code-fence rendering via the official Mermaid renderer with support for all current diagram types/features, in addition to route-owned dashboard pages and themed evidence popovers. Requirements/design must address Mermaid security configuration, renderer/library choice, and validation corpus. Deterministic validation and Mermaid addendum auditor PASS recorded.

Requirements/design artifacts created for approved dashboard-improvements proposal before implementation planning. Requirements cover route-owned dashboard navigation, route-derived active state, addressable topic surfaces, themed Markdown reference popovers, complete official Mermaid rendering, read-only/private-safe guarantees, and regression coverage. Design accepts route-owned IA, route/search state boundary, ReferencePopoverLink, official Mermaid renderer with feature-compatible security handling, and layered validation gates.

Finalized plan for dashboard-improvements. Six phases: P0 route shell foundation; P1 topic section pages; P2 Markdown reference popovers; P3 official Mermaid rendering with full current diagram support and security handling; P4 navigation UX polish; P5 final validation/docs/requirements fold/ADR readiness. Deterministic topic/planning-graph validations and plan auditor PASS recorded.

P0 Route Shell Foundation implemented and auditor-corrected. Added shared dashboard route descriptors/targets for overview, topics, topic default, documents, facts, evidence, receipts, health, and graph; moved shell primary navigation to route-derived active state with TanStack Link in route contexts and no primary scrollIntoView state navigation; added /topics route-owned topic index; added topic child route stubs/targets for upcoming P1 surfaces; updated route tree, router test history injection, and browser tests that mount the generated TanStack route tree for / -> /topics. P0 validation passed: typecheck, client-shell browser test, topic-pages test, dashboard build, topic JSONL, planning graph. P0 auditor PASS recorded after initial FAIL corrections; package-lock.json remains preserved as unrelated pre-existing change.

P1 (Topic Section Pages) implementation complete. Extracted TopicPageFrame, TopicDocumentPanel, TopicFactsPanel, TopicEvidencePanel, TopicReceiptsPanel, TopicHealthPanel, TopicGraphPanel, TopicPage, TopicMissingArtifactsPanel, and TopicMissingDocumentPanel from TopicWorkspace. Added renderContent prop to DashboardShell so each route renders its focused panel via TanStack Router Outlet (parent route conditionally renders child Outlet via isChildTopicPath detection). Updated /topics/$topic and all child routes to use the new focused rendering. All P1 tasks (T1-T5) and validations (V1-V3) are complete with passing test receipts: typecheck, topic-pages+graph-explorer (12 tests), browser client-shell (7 tests), privacy-regressions (3 tests), smoke test (1 test), topic JSONL validation, and planning graph validation. Pre-existing lint errors (3 in App.tsx and dashboard-routes.ts) are unchanged and out of P1 scope.

P2 (Markdown Reference Popovers) implementation complete. Added ReferencePopoverLink and ReferencePopoverBody components in dashboard/src/lib/markdown.tsx using existing Radix Tooltip primitives (no new dependency). The Markdown a component override routes reference links through ReferencePopoverLink and ordinary external/local links through plain a (no popover, no title). Native title attribute removed from all reference anchors. data-reference, data-reference-status, data-reference-kind, and aria-label are preserved. Blocked/outside-root paths are routed through the popover (markdownUrlTransform preserves original href so blockedLocalFileReference can fire). All 5 markdown-viewer tests, 3 privacy tests, 16 test files (55 tests total in tests/dashboard) pass. Pre-existing lint errors (3) unchanged.
